entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I need to start a return for an order.
I can certainly help you with that. Can you please provide me with your order number?
Yes, it's VF886-09B. It's for a helmet I purchased a little while ago.
Thank you. I see the order here for the AeroSafe Helmet. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's just a preference thing. The online color looked a bit different than it does in person, and it doesn't quite match the rest of my gear. The box is unopened, so it's in perfect condition.
I understand completely. Let me just check the purchase date... I see it was delivered 63 days ago. One moment while I review our policy.

Okay, I've confirmed it. Since the helmet is a standard VeloFit item and it's within our 90-day return window, I can absolutely process this return for you. We just need it back in its original condition, so it's good that the box is unopened, especially for a safety item like that.
That's great news, I appreciate it. Now, since I have to go through the trouble of packaging it and sending it back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next VeloFit purchase?

I understand your request, but unfortunately, our policy doesn't allow for goodwill credits or discounts for returns based on a change of preference. I can only process the full refund once we receive the item.
Alright, fair enough. I figured it was worth asking. So, what's the next step for the return?

I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. You should see the email in the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Nope, that's all. Thank you for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
